class.name: OcgGraphic3dCubemapseparate
class.brief_description: Class to manage cubemap located in six different images.
class.description: ! Class to manage cubemap located in six different images.

method.name: from_NCollection_Array1_of_TCollection_AsciiString_const_ref
method.description: Initializes cubemap to be loaded from file. - array of paths to separate image files (has to have size equal 6).

method.name: CompressedValue
method.description: Returns current cubemap side as compressed PixMap.

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns current side of cubemap as PixMap. Returns null handle if current side or whole cubemap is invalid. All origin images have to have the same sizes, format and quad shapes to form valid cubemap.

method.name: IsDone
method.description: Checks if a texture class is valid or not. Returns true if the construction of the class is correct.
